title: Fresh Approval Wrapper Clearance Creation Expired
claim: A fresh ChatGPT session could invoke the exposed guarded next-gate wrapper for clearance creation, and ForgePilot safely blocked progression because the approval had expired.
summary: Record that the Step 4 wrapper call was allowed by the ChatGPT host, but ForgePilot did not apply the gate because the FP-MCP-335 approval was expired or invalid. No clearance artifact was written, no approval was consumed, no runner endpoint was contacted, and OpenCode was not started.
caveats: This does not reach final guarded execution.
The result is dominated by approval expiration timing.
boundaries: No files written by the wrapper.
observedResult: A fresh ChatGPT session could invoke the exposed guarded next-gate wrapper for clearance creation, and ForgePilot safely blocked progression because the approval had expired.
